title: Setting up Temperance
subtitle: From a fresh install to the first family rules

steps.say: Temperance runs on a computer at home. Open its dashboard and sign in with the admin password the installer printed.
The first time you sign in, a short wizard sets up your first family member.
Pick an age. Each preset fills in sensible filters and a daily screen-time limit.
Block whole categories of sites, like social media…
…and give all of Jordan's games one shared daily budget.

fill.label: Minutes per day for all games together

steps.say: Jordan's rules are saved. Next you would connect a device; for now, head to the dashboard.
The overview shows each family member's day at a glance: time used, time left and what is blocked.
